explanation: This unit tracks time in the episode and mostly ignores choices and transitions: it sits at 10 for trials 0-20, about 9 for trials 20-40, 8-9 for trials 40-55, 7-8 for trials 60-75, 3-5 for trials 80-88 and 0-2 for trials 90-99. Within a trial, D2 reads 1-3 points above D1 and GO late in the episode (for example D2 about 3-5 while D1 is about 0-1 after trial 90), and D1 reads about 1 point lower when the previous trial was rewarded.
